no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not discussed at an advisory committee meeting as there were no issues that needed input from the committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA210910 (AEMCOLO/rifamycin) for travelers' diarrhea. The Multidisciplinary Review states the application was not discussed at an advisory committee meeting because there were no issues requiring committee input. Consequently there were no AdComm-driven changes to the approval.
